# ModAssetBundle <Badge type="info" text="class" />

<p class="api-meta">Namespace <code>Lustral</code> · Assembly <code>Lustral.Api</code></p>

A loaded asset bundle ([`ModAssets.LoadBundle`](/api/mod-assets#loadbundle-string)). Asset names are full lowercase paths as reported by Unity, such as `assets/ui/panel.prefab`; [`Load`](/api/mod-asset-bundle#load) also accepts the file name alone, such as `Panel`.

```csharp
public sealed class ModAssetBundle : IDisposable
```

## Properties

### AssetNames {#assetnames}

```csharp
public IReadOnlyList<string> AssetNames { get; }
```

The full paths of all assets in the bundle, such as `assets/ui/panel.prefab`.

### IsLoaded {#isloaded}

```csharp
public bool IsLoaded { get; }
```

Whether the bundle is still loaded, that is, it has not been unloaded by [`Unload`](/api/mod-asset-bundle#unload) or by the game.

### Name {#name}

```csharp
public string Name { get; }
```

The bundle's file name, or `(from memory)` for a bundle loaded from bytes.

## Methods

### Contains(string) {#contains}

public bool Contains(string name);

Returns whether the bundle contains an asset with the specified name or path.

### Dispose() {#dispose}

```csharp
public void Dispose();
```

Unloads the bundle without unloading the assets loaded from it (see [`Unload`](/api/mod-asset-bundle#unload)).

### Load&lt;T&gt;(string) {#load}

```csharp
public T Load<T>(string name) where T : class;
```

Loads an asset by name (`Panel`) or path (`assets/ui/panel.prefab`) as the specified type, for example a prefab as `GameObject`, or an image as `Texture2D` or `Sprite`.

**Type parameters**

- `T`: A Unity object type: `UnityEngine.Object` or a derived type.

**Exceptions**

- [`KeyNotFoundException`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.collections.generic.keynotfoundexception): The bundle contains no asset with that name and type.

### LoadAll&lt;T&gt;() {#loadall}

```csharp
public T[] LoadAll<T>() where T : class;
```

Loads all assets of type `T` in the bundle; all assets for `UnityEngine.Object`.

### LoadWithSubAssets&lt;T&gt;(string) {#loadwithsubassets}

```csharp
public T[] LoadWithSubAssets<T>(string name) where T : class;
```

Loads an asset and its sub-assets of type `T`, such as the sprites in a texture or the meshes in a model. Returns an empty array if the asset does not exist.

### ToString() {#tostring}

```csharp
public override string ToString();
```

A description for logs.

### Unload(bool) {#unload}

```csharp
public void Unload(bool unloadAssets = false);
```

Unloads the bundle. Assets already loaded from it remain loaded unless `unloadAssets` is true, in which case they are destroyed and objects still using them show missing textures or meshes. Has no effect if the bundle is already unloaded.
